title: Group Chat
blurb: Ghosts, voice-note essays, 3am memes and the one who never replies.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to send a voice note that lasts longer than a song?
Who is most likely to reply to a message from three days ago like it's fresh?
Who would be most likely to start a chat with "so I have news" and then vanish?
Who would send a meme at 3am and expect a response?
Who among us is most likely to mute the chat and miss the entire plan?
Who would be most likely to reply "haha" to something sad?
Who do you reckon is most likely to use only a thumbs up as a full reply?
Who's the one most likely to start an argument over what time to meet?
Who would be most likely to type for five minutes and send one word?
Who is most likely to leave the chat dramatically and rejoin ten minutes later?
Who would be most likely to take a screenshot and send it with no context?
Who would send a photo of their food to the whole group?
Who among us is most likely to rename the chat to something embarrassing?
Who would be most likely to post a poll about where to eat and then ignore the result?
Who do you reckon is most likely to send a voice message in a place where they should be quiet?
Who's the one most likely to use an emoji in a way that means something else entirely?
Who would be most likely to say "I'm on my way" while still in bed?
Who is most likely to post "who's free tonight?" and then not show up?
Who would be most likely to forget a birthday even with the group chat reminding them?
Who would type a novel when someone asks what time we are meeting?
Who among us is most likely to get everyone's hopes up about a trip and book nothing?
Who would be most likely to change their profile photo twelve times in one week?
Who do you reckon is most likely to say "can't talk now" and then post on socials?
Who's the one most likely to write "lol" without actually laughing?
Who would be most likely to be the group's unofficial news reporter?
Who is most likely to post the same joke twice?
Who would be most likely to send a message and then immediately delete it for everyone?
Who would ask for a restaurant recommendation and then pick their own?
Who among us is most likely to say "just the one" and message at 4am?
Who would be most likely to be the chat's detective, finding every old message as evidence?
Who do you reckon is most likely to post a throwback photo nobody asked for?
Who's the one most likely to have a hundred unread messages and never open them?
Who would be most likely to accidentally like a two-year-old photo while scrolling someone's profile?
Who is most likely to start a side chat about the main chat?
Who is the one who always asks "wait, what did I miss?"
Who would be most likely to send a dramatic goodbye message before going on holiday?
Who would flip out over a read receipt?
Who among us is most likely to post a video of themselves singing in the shower?
Who would be most likely to answer a question nobody asked?
Who do you reckon is most likely to reply with a gif instead of an actual answer?
Who's the one most likely to send a flirty message to the wrong chat?
Who would be most likely to have a secret chat with just one person from this group?
Who is most likely to screenshot a private message and share it?
Who would be most likely to send a risky text and then say "ignore that"?
